tools.name: list_parameters
tools.description: List design parameters with their current value, unit, kind and who defines them. Filter by id prefix (space.bedroom, door., light.), by who (client/designer/code), by kind or by free text.

tools.name: explain_parameter
tools.description: Explain one parameter: value, unit, allowed range or choices, code limit (rule and source), kind, who defines it, source and verification status.

tools.name: propose_change
tools.description: Validate a change of one parameter in the current profile without applying it; returns ok, problems (range, code limit, constraints) and warnings.

value.description: New value: number, text (enum), true/false or a list of texts

tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Apply one or more validated changes to the current profile with a reason; fails as a whole if any change is invalid. Setting a value back to the baseline removes the change.

value.description: New value: number, text (enum), true/false or a list of texts

tools.name: diff_profile
tools.description: Parameters of the current profile that differ from the baseline.

tools.name: get_criteria
tools.description: Area budget or door interference criteria by layer. group=area: per space type the code floor, the program range (catalog min/target/max, least side) and the design criteria (recommended, absolute cap, share of the net program area), the policy (hierarchy ratios, suite vs garage, size factor, use of the freed area, extra-room policy) and, given house_net_sqft, the effective maximum and which limit binds. group=doors: the door interference rules and tolerances. group=structure: the upper floor's structure (joist and beam spans, which walls must share an axis, snap reach, cantilever), the stair arrival node and the grouping of bedroom doors.

tools.name: set_criteria
tools.description: Change area or door criteria with a reason (validated like apply_changes; fails as a whole). group=area with space_type: keys cap_sqft, min_side_ft, program_max_sqft, program_min_sqft, program_target_sqft, rec_sqft, share_max. group=area without space_type: policy keys (the id after 'space.area.', e.g. suite_to_bedroom_max, extra_room_policy). group=doors: the id after 'door.conflicts.' (e.g. approach_depth_ft). group=structure: the full id or its last part (e.g. joist_span_max_ft, node_short_side_max_ft, nearest_corner).

additionalProperties.description: New value: number, text (enum), true/false or a list of texts

tools.name: run_variant
tools.description: Run the generator on pilot lots with the current profile and return quality indicators (available from step S2.2f).

tools.name: compare_variants
tools.description: Compare the quality indicators of two runs (available from step S2.2f).
